# UI Generation Prompt — Pure Tailwind + HTML Tool UI

Design a functional, beautiful, and immediately usable tool UI using only Tailwind CSS and semantic HTML. No component libraries. No gradients. No AI-slop aesthetics. Every visual decision must serve the user's task — but "functional" is not an excuse for plain.

---

## 1. The Golden Rule

**If it looks like it was generated by an AI, redesign it.**

### Red Flags to Eliminate Immediately

- Purple, violet, or indigo gradients on hero sections or buttons
- `rounded-2xl` cards with `shadow-lg` wrapping every section
- Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur`, semi-transparent cards) used decoratively
- Gradient text (`bg-clip-text text-transparent`)
- Centered layouts with a floating card on a gradient background
- Icon grids with colored circle backgrounds for every feature
- "Get Started Free" buttons with a sparkle emoji

> If any of these appear in the output, it is wrong. Start over.

---

## 2. Aesthetic Direction

Pick one of these directions and commit fully. Do not blend them.

| Direction          | Feel                  | Key Signals                                                      |
| ------------------ | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Editorial / Clean  | NYT, Linear, Stripe   | Tight type, lots of white, one accent color, no decoration       |
| Utilitarian / Dense | VS Code, Notion, Figma | Small type, high info density, muted palette, monospace details  |
| Warm / Crafted     | Basecamp, Hey, Loom   | Slightly warm whites, friendly but not playful, tactile feel     |
| Dark / Precise     | Vercel, Raycast, Fig  | Dark zinc background, near-white text, sharp borders, cool accents |

Each direction has a distinct typographic voice, spacing rhythm, and color logic. Pick one and let it govern every decision.

---

## 3. Typography System

Typography is the single most powerful design tool available in pure HTML/CSS. Use it.

### Font Pairing Rules

- Import **1–2 fonts from Google Fonts** — never use system fonts as the primary face
- **Display/heading:** something with character — DM Serif Display, Playfair Display, Syne, Space Grotesk, Instrument Serif
- **Body/UI:** something clean and legible — DM Sans, Inter (acceptable only if the aesthetic demands neutrality), IBM Plex Sans, Geist
- **Code/output values:** always `font-mono` — JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, or system mono

### Hierarchy Rules

- Maximum **3 type sizes** on screen at once
- **Weight contrast** carries more visual weight than size contrast — a `font-black` label at 14px reads stronger than a `font-normal` at 24px
- Output values, results, and numbers should be **large and heavy** — make the result feel like a result
- Helper text and metadata: `text-xs` or `text-sm`, muted, never the same weight as labels
- Never use `text-center` on body copy — only on isolated single-line headings

---

## 4. Color Philosophy

**One neutral base. One accent. Semantic only beyond that.**

### Base Palette

- `zinc`, `slate`, `stone`, or `neutral` — pick one gray family and use only that

### Accent Color

- One color, used in **at most 3 places** — primary button, active/focus state, one highlight
- Good accent choices: `blue-500`, `emerald-500`, `rose-500`, `orange-500`
- Avoid `indigo` and `violet` entirely

### Surface Hierarchy (Without Shadows)

| Surface        | Light Mode                    | Dark Mode                      |
| -------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Page background | `bg-white`                    | `bg-zinc-950`                  |
| Secondary zones | `bg-zinc-50`                  | `bg-zinc-900`                  |
| Input fields   | `bg-white` + `border-zinc-200` | `bg-zinc-800` + `border-zinc-700` |
| Dividers       | `border-zinc-200`             | `border-zinc-800`              |

- **Dark mode:** use Tailwind's `dark:` prefix throughout — not as an afterthought, but designed simultaneously

### Never

- Mix two accent colors
- Use color to decorate — only to communicate state (hover, active, error, success)
- Use `bg-gradient-to-*` on any UI surface

---

## 5. Layout Rules

Structure through spacing and typography, not boxes.

- Separation comes from **whitespace**, `border-b`, and **background tone shifts** — not from wrapping things in bordered containers
- Use a **max-width container** (`max-w-2xl` or `max-w-3xl`) centered for tool UIs — wide enough to breathe, narrow enough to focus
- **Single-column flow** for forms and tools — top to bottom, one decision at a time
- **Two-column** only for genuine input → output comparison
- The page header (tool name + description) should be **flush left**, not centered, for anything beyond a one-liner tool
- **Avoid:** multiple nested `div` wrappers that add no semantic meaning — flatten the DOM

### Spacing Rhythm

Use a consistent vertical spacing scale. Pick one and don't deviate:

| Gap Type                          | Spacing              |
| --------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| Between major sections            | `py-10` or `py-12`   |
| Between a label and its input     | `mb-2`               |
| Between stacked inputs            | `space-y-5` or `space-y-6` |
| Between a section heading and content | `mt-3` or `mt-4`   |

---

## 6. Component Patterns (No Library — Build Them Right)

### Inputs

```html
<div class="space-y-1.5">
  <label class="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Label</label>
  <input class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 text-sm bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 rounded-md text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent transition" />
  <p class="text-xs text-zinc-400">Helper text here</p>
</div>
```

### Primary Button

```html
<button class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-white text-white dark:text-zinc-900 text-sm font-semibold rounded-md hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-100 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-zinc-900">
  Action Label
</button>
```

### Section Separator

```html
<div class="border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 pt-6 mt-6">
  <h2 class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-400 mb-4">Section Name</h2>
</div>
```

### Output / Result Zone

```html
<div class="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 rounded-md px-4 py-4 mt-4 border border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
  <p class="text-xs text-zinc-400 mb-1">Result</p>
  <p class="text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-white font-mono">OUTPUT VALUE</p>
</div>
```

### Inline Error

```html
<p class="text-xs text-red-500 mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">
  <svg .../>  Error message here
</p>
```

### Tabs (No JS Library)

```html
<div class="flex gap-1 p-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded-md w-fit">
  <button class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium rounded bg-white dark:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-900 dark:text-white shadow-sm">Active</button>
  <button class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors">Inactive</button>
</div>
```

---

## 7. Interaction Patterns

| Pattern            | Behavior                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Primary action result | Appears inline directly below the button — no page reload, no modal      |
| Copy button        | Icon swaps to a checkmark for 1.5s on click — no toast                   |
| Loading state      | Button becomes disabled + shows a small inline spinner inside it — no skeleton screens |
| Error state        | Appears as `text-red-500` text directly beneath the relevant input — not a banner, not a toast |
| Empty output state | One line of muted centered text — nothing more                           |
| Success            | A `text-green-600` checkmark + short message inline — no celebration, no confetti |

---

## 8. What Never Appears in This UI

Treat these as **hard constraints** — if any appear, remove them:

- `bg-gradient-to-*` on any surface, button, or text
- `shadow-xl`, `shadow-2xl` on any element
- `backdrop-blur` used decoratively
- `rounded-2xl` or `rounded-3xl` on cards or containers (use `rounded-md` or `rounded-lg` max)
- Emoji in UI labels or buttons
- Decorative SVG illustrations or blob shapes
- Icon circles with colored backgrounds for every list item
- More than one ring or glow effect visible at a time
- Centered hero text layout for a tool UI
- `text-transparent bg-clip-text` gradient text

---

## 9. Self-Check Before Outputting

### Visual Sanity

- [ ] Does this look like it was designed by a human who cares, or auto-generated?
- [ ] Is there a single gradient anywhere? (If yes: remove it)
- [ ] Are there more than 3 `rounded-2xl` elements? (If yes: reduce to `rounded-md`)
- [ ] Does the accent color appear more than 3 times? (If yes: strip it back)
- [ ] Does dark mode look designed, not just inverted?

### UX Sanity

- [ ] Is the primary action visible without scrolling?
- [ ] Does every input have a visible label?
- [ ] Is there any nesting deeper than 3 levels visually?
- [ ] Does the result feel clearly different from the input?
- [ ] Would a power user find it fast? Would a first-time user find it obvious?

### Code Quality

- [ ] Is the HTML semantic? (`<main>`, `<section>`, `<label>`, `<output>` where appropriate)
- [ ] Are all interactive elements keyboard accessible?
- [ ] Is the JS minimal and inline — no unnecessary abstractions?
- [ ] Does it work without JavaScript for basic rendering?

> If any answer is wrong, revise before outputting.

---

## 10. Output Format

- Single HTML file
- Tailwind via CDN
- Google Fonts via `<link>`
- Vanilla JS only — no frameworks, no build tools
- Semantic HTML5
- `dark:` classes throughout
- No inline styles unless a value cannot be expressed in Tailwind utilities
